question: What exact external controller and evidence boundary can judge the unchanged double-double refinement witness route without treating a normal macOS proc_pidinfo ESRCH at process exit as a candidate-owned thread failure?

forbidden: dependency, feature, precision, stop-rule, witness, RHS, reference, threshold, resource, cancellation, worker-profile, target, or lane changes
reuse or mixing of Issue 49 candidate observations

candidate_controls: unchanged-candidate status-vector replay before refined entry
candidate-independent frozen-system solution enclosure and unchanged 256*n*2^-53 threshold
exact N-minus-one denial including 168*n owned refinement bytes
typed factor, correction-solve, and refinement cancellation

materialization_and_binding.candidate_boundary: The Rust candidate subtree, Cargo.lock, dependency versions, features, target configuration, double-double precision and stop rule must reproduce unchanged candidate binding 1cd16d8c0ef14f01849af440df53a64b06dbaf0adcd46ac6926b0625634785e6 byte-for-byte. Only the external Python controller, cohort verifier, execution contract, and workflow may differ from Issue 49.
materialization_and_binding.single_commit_rule: Before candidate entry, materialize exactly one pushed commit containing the unchanged candidate plus the controller-only change. Every job checks out that exact commit with clean=true and fetch-depth=1.
materialization_and_binding.controller_binding_algorithm: For the allowlisted controller, verifier, execution-contract, workflow, and prototype-plan paths, hash each exact blob with SHA-256, sort records by UTF-8 path bytes, serialize each as '<path>\u0000<lowercase-sha256>\n', and SHA-256 the concatenation. Record the resulting controller_binding_sha256 in every preflight, target, and cohort artifact.
materialization_and_binding.source_binding_rule: The source binding manifest contains the exact git commit, unchanged candidate binding, controller binding, Cargo.lock SHA-256, dependency and feature inventory, plan and reference hashes, and all allowlisted blob hashes. Canonical JSON is UTF-8, LF, sorted keys, no insignificant whitespace; its SHA-256 is the source_binding_sha256. All four targets must report one identical source binding.

toolchain_rule.lane_identity: Each lane records runner image label and image version, OS build/kernel, architecture/ISA witness, target triple, rustc -vV, cargo -V, Python implementation/version/executable SHA-256, and linker identity. The target job must equal that lane's same-attempt zero-entry preflight on every declared field; a mismatch is external invalidity.

materialization_and_binding.no_issue49_evidence_promotion: Issue 49 observations may be replayed only as named controller-diagnostic traces. No Issue 49 profile, candidate file, target observation, maximum, or disposition may appear in the replacement cohort or satisfy any minimum-evidence count.

controller_state_machine.process_identity: A random invocation nonce plus the controller-owned subprocess object/OS child handle identifies the process. PID is diagnostic only and never sufficient for reconciliation.

owners.waiter: One dedicated waiter is the sole owner of wait/reap and emits exactly one terminal event with monotonic timestamp, return code or signal, and the same invocation nonce.
owners.sampler: One sampler emits timestamped native thread-count attempts every 2 ms while no terminal event is set. It never polls, waits, reaps, or infers termination from PID absence.
owners.deadline: One monotonic 7200-second deadline owner emits timeout, terminates the same child handle, and delegates final reap to the sole waiter.

controller_state_machine.process_tree_scope: Launch the root in a fresh non-breakaway Windows Job Object or fresh POSIX process group. Every successful sample is the sum of the root and every member, with per-process start identity and thread count retained. Windows obtains the job PID inventory and a Toolhelp thread snapshot; Linux scans /proc for the exact process group and binds each PID to /proc/<pid>/stat starttime before counting /proc/<pid>/task; macOS uses proc_listpids(PROC_PGRP_ONLY) and binds each PID through PROC_PIDTBSDINFO before PROC_PIDTASKINFO. A membership, identity, or descendant-count race is an invalid sampling error rather than a lower count. The macOS ESRCH exception below applies only to the root PROC_PIDTASKINFO call paired to the root sole-waiter event. Cleanup proves the Job Object/process group is empty after root reap.
controller_state_machine.successful_sample: A platform adapter must return complete native records, stable per-process identities, and a summed live subject-process-tree thread count >= 1 for the same root invocation. The sum updates the ordered sample count and maximum; the per-process inventory remains in evidence.

macos_esrch_rule.eligible_error: Only errno 3 / ESRCH returned by macOS proc_pidinfo(PROC_PIDTASKINFO) for the one in-flight sample is eligible.
macos_esrch_rule.terminal_first_order: If the waiter terminal event is already serialized, ESRCH is BENIGN_TERMINAL_RACE only when the sample began no later than the terminal-observed timestamp and finished no earlier than it.
macos_esrch_rule.sample_first_order: If ESRCH is serialized first, sampling stops and the controller waits at most 1000 ms for the same subprocess handle's waiter event. Matching closure is BENIGN_TERMINAL_RACE.
macos_esrch_rule.effect: BENIGN_TERMINAL_RACE is retained verbatim in the event log, does not increment sampling_errors, adds no thread sample, cannot lower the observed maximum, and ends sampling.
macos_esrch_rule.failure: Wrong handle/nonce, a sample begun after terminal observation, no waiter closure within 1000 ms, more than one eligible terminal race, or any controller kill before closure is external controller invalidity.

controller_state_machine.all_other_sampling_errors: Every non-eligible errno, exception, short native record, zero/negative count, adapter failure, malformed timestamp, event-order violation, and cross-process identity mismatch is external controller invalidity. It is never converted to a candidate-owned failure and is never retried within a coordinate.
controller_state_machine.process_result: The sole waiter result, candidate-entry marker hash, stdout/stderr hashes, candidate output hash or absence, timeout/kill history, and invocation nonce form one process-result record. A missing entry marker is external invalidity. After entry, a nonzero exit, signal, or timeout is a valid candidate-owned nonpass and cannot be masked by thread evidence.
controller_state_machine.hard_thread_ceiling: Thread evidence passes only with at least one successful live sample, complete terminal/reap closure, no invalid sampling event, and maximum_live_threads <= the profile grant. Any valid observed count above the grant after candidate entry is a candidate-owned nonpass. BENIGN_TERMINAL_RACE cannot itself pass the gate.

checks: recompute candidate, controller, source, plan, reference, transport, dependency, feature, and toolchain identities
build the unchanged candidate without executing it
run the pure frozen state traces for terminal-first ESRCH, sample-first ESRCH, unpaired ESRCH, other sampling error, over-grant, timeout, pre-entry exit, and zero-successful-sample cases
run a controller-only native helper behind a start barrier for one-thread and grant-plus-one detection
run 256 controller-only fast-exit children and retain every raw event; observed ESRCH must close through the same-handle waiter rule, while absence of ESRCH is allowed
fault-inject ESRCH without waiter closure and one non-ESRCH adapter error and require external invalidity
prove the sole waiter reaps every helper and no helper, scratch, or output survives
zero_candidate_entry_preflight.admission: All checks and all identities pass on all four lanes in one attempt. Otherwise candidate jobs do not start and the attempt is INVALID_UNJUDGED.

minimum_profile_evidence: exact lane, target, profile, source binding, controller binding, toolchain witness, plan, reference, and transport identities
invocation nonce, diagnostic PID, executable hash, argv hash, selected environment hash, cwd identity, start and deadline timestamps
ordered append-only launch, sampling, reconciliation, terminal, timeout/kill, and reap event log with monotonic timestamps
at least one successful thread sample, sample count, maximum, grant, every raw adapter result, and zero or one explicitly reconciled BENIGN_TERMINAL_RACE
sole-waiter return code or signal and matching reaped result
stdout, stderr, baseline, candidate-entry, candidate-report, scratch-inventory, and cleanup hashes or an explicit justified absence
all inherited numerical, reload, resource, cancellation, prior-state, publication, and cleanup controls

cohort_and_judgment.complete_cohort: Exactly four target observations, each with exactly the 1/12, 2/12, and 8/16 profiles, exactly six witness sources and 18 RHS identities, from one workflow run attempt, one commit, one source/controller/candidate binding, one reference, one transport, and one preflight cohort.
cohort_and_judgment.mixing: No target, profile, preflight, candidate observation, or sidecar may be filled from another run, attempt, commit, controller binding, or Issue 49.
cohort_and_judgment.integrity: Every artifact has byte length and SHA-256 in its parent manifest; the cohort verifier independently rehashes all descendants and rejects duplicate, missing, unexpected, or unreferenced evidence.
precedence: Any external identity, preflight, controller, transport, evidence, integrity, or completeness invalidity makes the complete attempt INVALID_UNJUDGED.
Otherwise any valid candidate-owned numerical, resource, cancellation, thread, process, publication, or cleanup nonpass makes the complete attempt REFINEMENT_ROUTE_REJECTED_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY.
cohort_and_judgment.supported_scope: Support freezes a separate full-corpus refined-factor qualification plan; it does not admit faer, qd, a factor route, or the corpus.

immutable_retry.attempt_unit: One complete four-target workflow dispatch and its same-attempt preflight, reference, target, and cohort artifacts.
immutable_retry.replacement_condition: Attempt 2 exists only after an audited INVALID_UNJUDGED disposition for attempt 1 and explicit live human ratification.
immutable_retry.replacement_identity: Attempt 2 must use the exact same commit, source/controller/candidate binding, toolchains, plan, reference, transport, targets, profiles, witnesses, RHS identities, thresholds, resources, and workflow inputs.
forbidden: replacement after a valid supported or rejected disposition
semantic or controller repair between attempts
selection of the more favorable attempt
immutable_retry.finality: Attempt 2 consumes the only replacement. If it is invalid, the execution ticket resolves INVALID_UNJUDGED; any repair requires a new Wayfinder decision ticket and a new plan.

issue49_diagnostic_interpretation.allowed: Replay the five macOS [Errno 3] proc_pidinfo traces as controller diagnostic inputs and show that maxima 2/3 under grants 12/12 on arm64 and 2/3/7 under grants 12/12/16 on x86_64 remain unchanged while each same-handle terminal race closes.
issue49_diagnostic_interpretation.not_allowed: Promote those maxima, candidate reports, sources, profiles, sidecars, or dispositions into the replacement cohort or count them toward any execution gate.
